BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I opened a money market account at a bank that advertised that they give 1.5% interest. It turned out they only give 0.5% interest. Is there anything I can do about this? Are they obligated to give me 1.5% interest? ASSISTANT:
No, unfortunately there is nothing you can do. Money market accounts are subject to interest rate changes and the bank is not obligated to give you 1.5% interest.
